text: 浙江工业大学中国住房和房地产研究院院长虞晓芬介绍，现房销售，则更强调“所见即所得”，契合存量房时代运行逻辑。过去数十年我国住房供需缺口大，预售制度充分发挥了加速住房供给、快速回笼资金的优势，有效缓解了城镇化快速推进阶段的住房供给短缺矛盾，适配了行业高速发展需求。但当前我国住房市场格局已发生根本性转变，城镇居民人均住房建筑面积已超过40平方米，存量市场、增量市场供给充足，二手房销售面积占比过半，房地产发展目标需要从规模转向质量，市场主要矛盾已从“有没有”转向“好不好”，行业发展逻辑彻底重构。国家推进现房销售，是顺应市场的演化趋势，适配供求关系发生重大变化的
text_en: Yu Xiaofen, dean of the China Housing and Real Estate Research Institute at Zhejiang University of Technology, noted that spot sales emphasize 'what you see is what you get,' aligning with the operational logic of the existing-home era. Over the past decades, China faced a large housing supply-demand gap, and the presale system fully leveraged its advantages in accelerating housing supply and swiftly recovering funds, effectively easing the housing shortage during rapid urbanization and matching the industry's high-speed development needs. However, the current housing market landscape has fundamentally shifted: per-capita residential floor space in urban areas exceeds 40 square meters, both existing and new supply are ample, second-hand sales account for over half of transactions, and development goals must pivot from scale to quality. The main market contradiction has shifted from 'having or not having' to 'good or bad,' and the industry's operational logic has been thoroughly restructured. Promoting spot sales aligns with market evolution trends and adapts to the major changes in supply-demand relations.
